tips.text: Run Radiant relics in a four-player radshare to chase the Rare Systems and Chassis.
Refine Rare and Uncommon relics to Radiant and leave Common ones Intact; Radiant lowers Common odds to 16.67%.
Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; you keep the item and they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
Bank Aya and buy relics whenever you can; neither expires when Varzia's stock rotates.
Buy extra Systems and Chassis relics; they are the Rare parts.
Buy her relics from the Market console on your Orbiter to skip the trip to Maroo's Bazaar.
